title: RAG Question-Answering Assistant
blurb: Answer questions over your own documents with citations, and measure how often it is right.
brief: Build a retrieval-augmented question-answering assistant. Ingest and chunk a set of documents, retrieve the most relevant chunks for a question, build a grounded prompt, call an LLM (behind a small interface so the provider can be swapped or mocked), and return an answer with citations to the source chunks. The assistant must refuse to answer when retrieval finds nothing relevant. Create an evaluation set of questions (including some unanswerable ones) and report retrieval recall and answer quality.
requirements: Ingestion and chunking with source metadata
A retrieval component returning the top-k chunks with scores
A prompt template that grounds the model in the retrieved context and requests citations
An LLM client interface that can be mocked in tests
A no-answer path when similarity is below a threshold
An evaluation script with answerable and unanswerable questions and reported metrics
deliverables: The assistant as a package with a command-line or small web interface
An evaluation set and a script that produces the metrics
Tests that run with a mocked LLM and no network
README documenting the architecture and the evaluation results
resume_bullet: Built a RAG assistant with chunked retrieval, grounded citations and a refusal path, evaluated on a labeled question set including unanswerable queries.
